title: Recurrence, symbolic dynamics, and wild attractors for unimodal maps
summary: In this paper, we construct families of unimodal maps with wild Cantor attractors and study, via symbolic dynamics, the interplay between recurrence properties of the critical orbit. Using kneading and co-kneading techniques, we provide a symbolic characterization of persistent recurrence in terms of cutting and co-cutting times, and relate it to other recurrence conditions, including the Collet--Eckmann condition.
